enchantment.grapnel.grapnel.desc: After using a fishing rod enchanted with §6[Grapnel]§r, reeling in pulls the player towards the bobber.
enchantment.grapnel.toughness.desc: Increases fishing line strength, allowing you to cast farther and reducing the chance of the line breaking.
grapnel.configuration.fallingBuffer.tool: When enabled, the player takes no fall damage on the first landing after using a fishing rod enchanted with §6[Grapnel]§r.
